subject: Locale commitment and tombstone evidence exchange
messages:
From: Gwen Liao <gwen.liao@everwell.health>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: locale commitment and tombstone evidence for our dedicated instance

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our security review for the dedicated deployment you provisioned for EverWell, our InfoSec team needs a concise Q&A and sample artifacts proving the following for tenant everwell-prod:

1) Region pinning: confirmation that primary compute, persistent volumes, and snapshots for the tenant are restricted to eu-west-1 (no replication outside the region).

2) Isolation guarantees: network/tenant isolation controls and any cross-tenant shared services that touch customer data (auditable list).

3) Deletion/wipe evidence: sample logs or runbook excerpts that demonstrate a full tenant wipe path (snapshot tombstone, backup sweep, key decommission) and an estimate for how long forensic artifacts remain after a wipe.

Can you provide a short runbook + example artifacts (redacted is fine) and a proposed acceptance checklist we can use to sign off? We have a compliance call with procurement on Monday and would like to include this in the packet.

Appreciate a short timeline.

Best,
Gwen
Gwen Liao
Security Manager, EverWell Health
security@everwell.health

Attachments: none in this message
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Gwen Liao <gwen.liao@everwell.health>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: locale commitment and tombstone evidence for our dedicated instance

Gwen —

Thanks for the clear ask. High-level response and deliverables below; attaching a draft runbook and a small sample wipe log for your review.

Quick answers:
- Region pinning: your dedicated pool is anchored to eu-west-1. Control plane metadata is global but tenant data (model weights cache, KV caches, persistent artifacts, and backups) are pinned to eu-west-1 and are not replicated to other regions unless you opt into geo-replication.

- Isolation: compute nodes and storage are tenant-scoped in the dedicated pool. Shared services that interact with metadata (scheduling, billing) operate in a separate network namespace and only surface anonymized identifiers.

- Deletion: our scrub flow includes (1) soft-delete + tombstone of snapshots, (2) trigger backup sweep job that removes replicas older than the tombstone threshold, (3) KMS key rotate + key-schedule for decryption key retirement, (4) final forensic sweep & log collection.

Deliverables attached: everwell_runbook_v0.9.pdf (runbook excerpts), sample_wipe-log-20260518.csv (redacted), snapshot_tombstone_playbook.md (playbook excerpt).

Acceptance checklist proposal (draft):
- Confirm region anchor in provisioning manifest (tenant_pin: eu-west-1)
- Export of host inventory for tenant nodes with AZ list
- Sample snapshot tombstone entry + confirmation of backup sweep execution
- KMS key ID used for tenant and key-schedule for retirement
- Signed attestation from Redwood infra team that no cross-region replicas exist

Next steps: Neha, can you validate the checklist items (inventory export + KMS key id) and confirm the forensic artifact retention period? Kimberly/Ben — tagging you for SLA/ops notes.

Timeline: we can send the completed checklist and the exported inventory by Friday EOD if that works.

Thanks,
Mateo
Head of Solutions — Dedicated Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: everwell_runbook_v0.9.pdf (pdf, 72KB); sample_wipe-log-20260518.csv (csv, 24KB); snapshot_tombstone_playbook.md (text, 6KB)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Gwen Liao <gwen.liao@everwell.health>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: locale commitment and tombstone evidence for our dedicated instance

Gwen / team —

Couple of technical confirmations and clarifications from ops:

- Inventory export: attached is a redacted host inventory showing node IDs, AZs (eu-west-1a/b), and the storage prefixes for tenant everwell-prod. These hosts are provisioned in the dedicated pool tagged everwell-prod; there are no cross-region clones.

- Snapshot tombstone semantics: when a snapshot is tombstoned we set tombstone_ts and immediately enqueue a sweep job. Sweep jobs run hourly during the 72-hour forensic window, and then a final archival purge job runs at the 30-day mark for cold backups (we keep audit traces for 365 days by default unless contract states otherwise).

- Backups: active backups for the tenant live only in eu-west-1. Cold backup metadata may be exported as an immutable manifest for compliance if you need transfer to a third party under documented export procedures.

- KMS: tenant uses a customer-managed key (CMK) in eu-west-1 under your account. Key decommissioning is part of the tombstone procedure — we rotate and schedule deletion in coordination with you; actual key destroy requires confirmation from EverWell.

Open questions for you:
1) Do you require a signed attestation (we can provide a DocuSign-ready form)?
2) Is the 365-day audit evidence retention sufficient or do you need a shorter window for forensic traces?

I attached: redacted_inventory_everwell.csv and a small excerpt of the sweep log (sample_wipe-log-20260518.csv was attached earlier).

-Neha
Sr. Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redacted_inventory_everwell.csv (csv, 18KB); sample_wipe-log-20260518.csv (csv, 24KB)
From: Gwen Liao <gwen.liao@everwell.health>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: locale commitment and tombstone evidence for our dedicated instance

Thanks — this is exactly what we needed.

A few quick notes from our procurement/compliance intake:
- The 72-hour hourly sweep + 30-day cold purge cadence is acceptable. We will request the signed attestation for our records. Please prepare the DocuSign-ready attestation and include a single-line confirmation that no tenant data leaves eu-west-1 except under documented export procedures.

- For the signed attestation, include the KMS CMK id (we will redact the key material on our side) and the hostname inventory export you already provided is sufficient.

We should be able to close this on Monday if we receive the attestation and the small manifest link.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Gwen
Security Manager, EverWell Health

Forwarded-For-Record: Mateo, please drop the DocuSign link and the final attestation in this thread when ready.

Attachments: none
